stack.interactive_components: Livewire 3 installed and ready for extension
stack.styling: Static CSS with responsive mobile-first layout and IBM Plex Sans Arabic
stack.database: SQLite by default for local testing; migrations are compatible with MySQL
stack.authentication: Laravel session authentication using Auth facade for internal admin/staff users only

database_mysql.note: Set these values in .env before running migrations.

production_notes: Run php artisan config:cache, php artisan route:cache, and php artisan view:cache.
Configure the scheduler with * * * * * php artisan schedule:run in the hosting cron system.
Use HTTPS and a persistent session/cache driver for production deployment.

identity_and_permissions.active_user_rule: Authenticated application routes are limited to internal users. Legacy partner-role users are preserved only as historical data and are blocked from active application access.
identity_and_permissions.admin_boundary: Admin or strict FinancialPermissions gates are required for commercial catalog configuration, financial accounts, accounting administration, reporting exports, SaaS metrics exports, settings, funding, assets, and legacy/archive administration.
identity_and_permissions.staff_boundary: Staff can perform normal CRM and operational work such as prospects, contacts, contact attempts, appointments, follow-ups, free installation workflow, review items, and operational queues.
identity_and_permissions.partner_policy: Partner records are referral/history metadata only. Partner login, dashboard, password reset, credential generation, partner-specific navigation, client visibility isolation, CSV ownership, operational notifications, and active financial/share dashboard logic are retired.

scheduled_commands.purpose: Idempotent operational reminders and commercial finance alert projections

manual_commands.purpose: Manual SaaS metric diagnostic/backfill review; intentionally not scheduled daily in production

automation_and_data_integrity.notification_idempotency: notifications.occurrence_key plus the user/type/source/occurrence unique key prevents duplicate scheduled notifications for the same source occurrence.
automation_and_data_integrity.financial_idempotency: Recurring obligations, V2 billing periods, revenue-recognition periods, metric events, cash movements, and reversal records retain source-identity constraints so scheduled finance commands are safe to rerun.
automation_and_data_integrity.failure_retry: Commands should be retried after inspecting actionable logs. Revenue recognition returns non-zero when ambiguous execution failures are encountered.

public.purpose: Create referral-attributed prospect or conflict review request without creating a user

schedule_generation.monthly: 12 monthly schedules starting on the subscription date
schedule_generation.installment: N schedules based on installments_count, one month apart

domain_workflows.timeline: Activity logs are appended after client creation, appointment changes, conversion, and payment receipt.
domain_workflows.historical_data: No hard-delete UI is provided for operational history; archival is represented by client closed/archived status and suspended partner referrer records.
domain_workflows.referral_attribution: partner_id and lead-source/referrer metadata preserve historical origin only. They do not control authorization, visibility, revenue, accounting, SaaS metrics, or recognized revenue.

verification.known_scope_note: Meeting outcome, CSV import, scheduled reminders, and full offer/follow-up forms are represented in the schema and domain foundation but need additional UI endpoints for a later production iteration.
